name: Algebraic Identity Disguise
description: Replaced the linear resonance sum target with a fake quadratic condition $10 S_i - Q_i = d_i(26 - 5c_i)$ that leverages the universal identity $v^2 - 11v + 24 = 0$ for $v \in \{3, 8\}$. This completely hides the fact that the target is simply the minimum/maximum possible sum, forcing the model to algebraically solve the quadratic system to discover the uniform endpoint role requirement (bipartiteness) rather than relying on surface pattern-matching of extreme values.
